India's Green Hydrogen Potential Discussed with Germany

India's growing renewable energy capacity presents an opportunity for it to become an energy exporter, particularly of green hydrogen. Germany's ambassador has identified this potential, viewing green hydrogen exports as a future avenue for India-Germany economic cooperation. A green hydrogen hub in Andhra Pradesh is highlighted as a significant opportunity by the CEO of NGEL. These developments align with broader discussions on artificial intelligence and potential EU Free Trade Agreements.
